negative_findings.result_summary: TED notice content is effectively invisible to general web search engines; only one real notice URL (ted.europa.eu/cs/notice/465605-2025/pdfs) surfaced incidentally, via the Czech-language query.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell CANNOT be worked by web search. Collection must go through TED's own search/API/bulk XML. Any pipeline design that assumes search-engine discoverability of notices will silently under-collect.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language queries containing 'platební terminály' and 'bankomaty' are dominated by retail/commercial content — bank product FAQs (Česká spořitelna Platbomat, ČSOB, Global Payments), accounting-software help pages, and terminal resellers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Majority of cs results were vendor marketing, not procurement documents.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are noisy terms. Czech procurement queries must be anchored with procedural vocabulary ('zadávací řízení', 'nadlimitní veřejná zakázka', 'profil zadavatele', 'oznámení o výsledku') or restricted to the procurement domains, or precision collapses.

negative_findings.description: No EU-funded programme or project specifically dedicated to Czech PAYMENTS infrastructure was identified. NPO/OP TAK/DIGITAL material describes digitalisation of public administration, healthcare, justice and building permits, plus generic business digitalisation — payments appears only implicitly (e-government payment gateways, digital identity).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched cs and en; found funding envelopes and digital pillars but no payments-specific programme line.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'EU-funded digitalisation programmes touching payments' half of this cell is thinner than assumed. Payments exposure has to be found bottom-up from individual tenders/beneficiaries rather than top-down from a programme line.

negative_findings.description: An authoritative CPV code-browser URL could not be confirmed; SIMAP content appears to have been folded into ted.europa.eu/en/simap. The candidate entry uses the inferred simap.ted.europa.eu/cpv URL with reduced confidence.
negative_findings.result_summary: No direct search hit for a canonical CPV browser page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The CPV whitelist is the backbone of every query in this cell; the canonical code list must be located and pinned before building the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: NIPEZ documentation indicates the original Czech open-data series covers procurement recorded in the Věstník and on e-marketplaces only through January 2024, after which the new Registr veřejných zakázek applies.
negative_findings.result_summary: A documented discontinuity in the Czech national open-data series around Jan 2024.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Time-series analysis of vendor win-share across that boundary will be misleading unless both the legacy and new datasets are ingested and reconciled. TED is the more continuous spine for above-threshold contracts.

negative_findings.description: No live fetch of TED search result pages, the TED API, or E-ZAK/NEN listings was performed in this pass; all findings rest on search-engine evidence and official documentation pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores but no liveness claim, per the run's rules.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must check especially the inferred URLs (simap CPV, celnisprava section index, isvz.nipez.cz/opendata) rather than the well-attested ones.

negative_findings.description: The public part of the Czech beneficial ownership register (Evidence skutečných majitelů, esm.justice.cz) was made inaccessible to the public by the Ministry of Justice effective 17 December 2025, citing Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court and CJEU case law on disproportionate interference with privacy.
negative_findings.result_summary: ESM can no longer be used as an open ownership-unmasking source; access is limited to the entity itself via data box, privileged public authorities, AML-obliged persons on request, or parties proving legitimate interest to a court.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This removes the single most direct route to identifying who really stands behind a CZ fintech or PSP; ownership analysis must fall back on shareholder entries in the obchodní rejstřík, Sbírka listin filings, LEI Level-2 parent data and foreign parent registers, all of which are less complete.

negative_findings.description: The 2024 amendment to the Czech transformations act removed the duty to publish paid notices about merger/transformation projects and creditor notices in the Obchodní věstník; the projekt přeměny and creditor notices are now deposited in the Sbírka listin at least one month before approval.
negative_findings.result_summary: M&A event detection has shifted from a searchable gazette feed to per-company document filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A monitoring pipeline built only on Obchodní věstník will silently miss vendor mergers and acquisitions from 2024 onward; watchlist-driven Sbírka listin polling is now required.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, publicly documented open-data dataset was found that extracts structured financial statement line items (revenue, EBITDA) from Sbírka listin PDFs for CZ companies; filings appear to be published as documents (often scans) rather than as structured XBRL-style data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Financial extraction from Czech statutory filings requires document download plus OCR/parsing, or a paid credit-bureau layer (CRIBIS, Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet-type providers).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cost and latency of the workstream's financial-evidence pipeline are materially higher than in jurisdictions with structured filing data; budget for OCR or a commercial licence.

negative_findings.description: Both ARES and the credit-bureau aggregators impose usage limits or licence conditions: MF ČR reserves the right to restrict users exceeding roughly 500 queries per minute or performing random-data automated crawling of ARES, and CRIBIS-type services are contractual databases that forbid bulk extraction.
negative_findings.result_summary: Automated collection must be rate-limited and, for commercial profiles, licence-based rather than scraped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ignoring these terms risks IP blocks on the single most important entity-resolution service for the whole CZ workstream.

negative_findings.description: German Unternehmensregister/Bundesanzeiger and some ČNB JERRS application endpoints were not fetched in this pass; their URLs are recorded from search results and prior knowledge, not from a successful retrieval.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as unverified rather than dead; liveness is to be established by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false 'dead source' records for portals that are typically session-driven or bot-defended.

negative_findings.description: No active, well-maintained Czech association dedicated specifically to non-bank payment institutions / PSPs with a public member list was confirmed. ASPPS ČR (aspps.eu, IČO 04387783) exists in the commercial register and describes an advocacy role, but its web presence looks minimal (plain http, .eu domain) and no member list was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: ASPPS ČR identified as the only candidate; membership depth unverified. In practice the PSP population is covered by Česká fintech asociace rather than a dedicated PSP body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means there is no single association-side census of Czech payment institutions; the ČNB licence register must carry that load, with ČEFTAS as the commercial-signal overlay.

negative_findings.description: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) appears under two domains (bankovnikarty.cz and bankovni-karty.cz) with legacy static-HTML page structures and no recent activity surfaced in search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Statutes and a 'činnost a členové' page were indexed, but currency could not be established in this pass. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SBK was historically the coordination venue for Czech card payments and card-market statistics; if dormant, that coordination has migrated to ČBA commissions and the schemes themselves, which changes where card-market intelligence should be collected.

negative_findings.description: APEK operates a members-only zone (apek.cz/prihlaseni) behind which richer member data and materials likely sit; only the public alphabetical member list is openly enumerable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public list is collectable; the member zone is out of scope and should not be accessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 580+ merchant enumeration remains usable, but any member-only vendor briefings or benchmark data are not legitimately collectable and should not be assumed available.

negative_findings.description: Searches surfaced association member and working-group directories but no association-hosted case-study or reference-implementation library for banking/payments technology in CZ.
negative_findings.result_summary: Associations publish position papers, rulebooks and statistics rather than vendor case studies; the closest substitutes found are ČBA scheme rulebooks and conference/PDF archives (e.g. ICT UNIE assembly minutes, ČBA presentations hosted on university sites).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'case studies' topic for this cell must be served indirectly — via association event programmes and member presentations — rather than by a directory. Another cell (vendor websites / conferences) should own it.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Banking Association is reachable under at least two domains — cbaonline.cz (current site, member list and working groups) and czech-ba.cz (the domain the ČNB index still links, with its own /cs/o-cba/komise-pracovni-organy path).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both appear live in search results; which is canonical was not established.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the wrong host risks silent staleness or duplicate records for the same association; the canonical host must be resolved before scheduling recurring collection.

negative_findings.description: No official award-programme domain for Zlatá koruna was confirmed during this pass; every result returned was syndicated press coverage (penize.cz, kurzy.cz, bankovnictvionline.cz, czechbanking.cz, profipf.cz, moneta.cz) rather than the organiser's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zlatá koruna is recorded as an indirect (PR-cluster) source pending resolution of its canonical domain. It is NOT assumed dead — only unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The organiser site would carry the full category tables, jury composition and multi-year archive that the press releases only summarise; without it, longitudinal award analysis depends on fragile third-party coverage.

negative_findings.description: The seed-adjacent term 'Zlatý měšec' returned no matching CZ award; searches redirected to 'Zlatá koruna' and to Měšec.cz (a consumer finance portal). The Czech-language query was run explicitly and did surface local results, just not the hypothesised award.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found in this pass that a currently-active award named 'Zlatý měšec' exists; treat the name as a noisy/possibly-defunct term rather than a source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a future run from burning queries on a non-existent programme, and flags 'měšec' as a noisy token that collides with the Měšec.cz brand.

negative_findings.description: No CZ event branded 'Banking Summit CZ' (as listed in the cell brief) was located in either Czech or English searching. The functional equivalents found are IT ve finančnictví, FIN (R)Evoluce, CARDFORUM and the new Fintech Week CEE.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'Banking Summit CZ' recorded as unconfirmed; possibly a generic descriptor rather than a brand, or a renamed/discontinued event.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a phantom source entry and redirects effort to the events that actually carry CZ bank + vendor line-ups.

negative_findings.description: No public exhibitor or sponsor roster was located for a Czech bank-run hackathon; Komerční banka's hackathon was documented only through a dated trade-press article, and no 2025 CZ bank hackathon results page surfaced in Czech-language search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank hackathon outputs (winning teams, partner tooling, mentor employers) appear to be published sporadically via PR rather than on stable pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hackathon winner and mentor lists are exactly the pre-press-release partnership signal the cell exists to capture; the absence of stable pages means this signal must be caught via press monitoring, not crawling.

negative_findings.description: Seamless Europe's most reliable index in this pass was its LinkedIn company page; the canonical event domain was not confirmed and LinkedIn requires authentication for full browsing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Exhibitor roster reachable in principle (200 exhibitors reported) but not via an unauthenticated, confirmed URL yet.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the two international delegation targets named in the cell brief currently lacks a crawlable entry point.

negative_findings.description: Money20/20 Europe attendee-level intelligence is available chiefly through commercial resellers (Landbase, Vendelux) rather than the organiser; the organiser publishes sponsors but not a full attendee list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sponsor directory is free and usable; attendee lists are a paid third-party product with unclear provenance.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations that CZ-delegation-level detail at international shows cannot be obtained free and reliably, and that reseller lists should not be treated as authoritative.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language queries targeting jobs.cz/prace.cz for vendor product names (Temenos, Mambu, Finastra) returned no actual CZ job listings; the general web index surfaced only US/UK aggregators (ZipRecruiter, ITJobsWatch).
negative_findings.result_summary: No individual CZ vacancy naming a core-banking vendor was retrieved via general web search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-value signal in this cell (a Prague ad requiring Temenos/Mambu experience) is not reachable through general search engines; it requires querying the job boards' own site search directly.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job search and employee skill profiles — the richest source for this cell — are behind an auth wall and their ToS forbids automated collection; search engines returned only public company landing pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CZ-filtered LinkedIn results obtainable; source recorded as blocked/manual-only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Employee skill profiles are often the only public proof that a bank runs a given platform; losing automated access forces manual analyst effort and slows detection.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated engineering blog was found for Komerční banka, ČSOB, Raiffeisenbank CZ, MONETA or Air Bank; only Česká spořitelna operates a public tech-community portal (ittrendy.cz).
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank tech-blog coverage in CZ is effectively a single-source category.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Weak-signal collection for the other banks must lean harder on job ads, API docs and GitHub, since they publish no engineering narrative.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language RFP-adjacent contractor/body-shop listing site specific to banking IT was identified in this pass; searches surfaced only generic IT job boards (easy-prace.cz, jenprace.cz, dobraprace.cz).
negative_findings.result_summary: Contractor/subcontractor-listing sub-category unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Subcontractor and freelance listings often name the end client's platform explicitly and would be a distinct early-warning channel.

negative_findings.description: No Printec Czech Republic careers page or CZ job listing was found; only Diebold Nixdorf (Prague, Plzeň) and NCR Atleos global careers surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Printec CZ hiring footprint unconfirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence of local hiring artefacts for a self-service/ATM vendor is itself a competitive-footprint signal, but needs confirmation rather than inference from a single search.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-specific Downdetector-equivalent outage archive with historical, queryable data was located. Searches surfaced only journalistic write-ups of outages (Deník, Peníze.cz, aRecenze) rather than a structured status/outage dataset for CZ banks, gateways or card schemes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Downdetector CZ country pages were not confirmed in results; outage evidence is currently only narrative press coverage plus, presumably, individual bank status pages not yet enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Outage frequency/duration per institution is one of the strongest demand-side quality signals for this cell; without a structured feed the workstream must reconstruct timelines from press, which is slower and biased toward large incidents.

negative_findings.description: Public operator pages for DPP/PID contactless fare payment describe terminal counts and the DOS/XT-Card carrier ecosystem but do not name the acquirer, terminal supplier or payment processor behind the open-loop card acceptance.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search explicitly returned that no concrete supplier for the in-vehicle contactless acceptance was identified in operator or PID materials.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor attribution for the flagship CZ transit deployment is missing, so acquirer/terminal-vendor market-share inference in transport is currently unsupported from buy-side sources alone.

negative_findings.description: APEK's flagship E-commerce Study (payment-method mix) is free only to association members; non-members face a purchase barrier.
negative_findings.result_summary: APEK announcement page states the 2025 study is free for members; full datasets are not openly downloadable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The best quantitative payment-mix time series for CZ e-commerce cannot be collected by crawling and needs a licensing/membership decision.

negative_findings.description: Merchant-side disclosure for Notino and Košík of their payment providers was not found; only Alza (Adyen) and Rohlík (Adyen listed among online-payment services, plus crypto work with Confirmo) yielded provider-level evidence in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on Notino/Košík payment providers returned no primary or trade-press provider attribution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves gaps in the top-merchant PSP map that this cell is supposed to build; requires checkout-level technical fingerprinting or subprocessor/privacy-policy inspection instead of search.

negative_findings.description: For consumer outage-tracking platforms there is no established Czech-language term or local service; searches had to rely on the English brand 'Downdetector' plus cs terms 'výpadek'/'nedostupnost'.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs terms 'výpadek', 'odstávka', 'nedostupnost' work for press coverage but no local crowd-outage platform exists in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents that local-language coverage for this sub-topic is inherently limited, not an omission by the scout.

negative_findings.description: No ČNB open-data CSV dataset specifically for payment institutions / e-money institutions / small-scale payment service providers was confirmed on the Otevřená data page. The datasets observed were banks and foreign bank branches (p_seznam=1), money changers (2), credit intermediaries (3, and further categories) and non-bank consumer credit providers (7).
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-sector entities appear to be reachable via JERRS and possibly WS JERRS, but a dedicated bulk open-data export for platební instituce was not evidenced in the fetched page content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments register is the backbone of this cell; if no bulk export exists, collection needs either the certificate-gated WS JERRS API or careful scraping of JERRS, which materially changes the effort estimate.

negative_findings.description: WS JERRS web services require authentication with a commercial certificate from eIdentity, I.CA, PostSignum or an EU trust-list CA.
negative_findings.result_summary: The official API is not anonymously accessible; this is documented policy rather than a fetch failure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any plan assuming a free public API over the ČNB register is wrong; budget for certificate procurement or design around open data / scraping.

negative_findings.description: The DORA 'registr informací' (register of ICT third-party providers and contractual arrangements) submitted annually by each financial entity to ČNB is a supervisory reporting artefact, not a published register.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only ČNB's templates, webinar decks and reporting guidance are public; the actual bank-to-vendor mappings are confidential.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This would be the single most valuable vendor-relationship dataset in the CZ market if it were public. It is not — vendor mapping must be reconstructed from procurement, enforcement decisions, and company disclosures instead.

negative_findings.description: No settled Czech-language term or dedicated regulator page was found for 'case study' / vendor reference project in a supervisory context; searches in cs surfaced only 'stanoviska', 'rozhodnutí' and 'zprávy'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Case-study material from the regulator side exists only implicitly, embedded in enforcement decisions, arbitrator findings and supervision reports.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a regulator-published case-study source in CZ; case studies must be mined from decision texts or sought in vendor/press cells.

negative_findings.description: No ČNB-published list of pending/ongoing licence applications (a forward-looking pipeline of prospective payment institutions) was found in either cs or en searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the licensing process description and the register of granted authorisations were located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: New-entrant detection will therefore be lagging (visible only on licence grant) unless supplemented by media, funding and trade-register sources.

negative_findings.description: No engineering/technology blog owned by any of the eleven target CZ banks was found. Searches in Czech for 'technologický blog', 'blog pro vývojáře', 'engineering blog' plus bank names returned only consumer media and comparison sites, no bank-hosted tech blog and no bank Medium publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero owned tech-blog sources identified for ČS, KB, ČSOB, Moneta, RB, UniCredit CZ, Air Bank, Fio, Creditas, Trinity, Partners Banka.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tech blogs are usually the richest owned source of vendor/stack detail. Their apparent absence means vendor intelligence for CZ must lean on IR/annual reports and vendor-side case studies instead.

negative_findings.description: No owned-channel announcement was found in which Air Bank, Fio banka, Banka CREDITAS or Partners Banka names its core-banking system vendor. Czech-language queries combining bank names with 'core banking systém', 'dodavatel' and 'tisková zpráva' returned only third-party profiles and aggregator directories.
negative_findings.result_summary: Core-banking vendor for the four challenger/small banks is undisclosed on their own channels as far as this pass could see.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale only partially: challengers do not self-disclose core vendors the way KB did. Vendor-side channels (cell for vendor press rooms) will have to carry this.

negative_findings.description: Landing-page URLs for several owned document hubs were inferred from observed PDF paths and site structure rather than seen directly: KB výsledky hospodaření hub, Air Bank výroční zprávy page, UniCredit Bank CZ výroční zprávy page, Banka CREDITAS 'pro média' page, Fio 'o nás' Czech path. The linked PDFs/subpages were observed in search results; the hub URLs were not.
negative_findings.result_summary: Five candidate source_url values are best-guess hub paths pending deterministic verification.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A verification pass should resolve these to canonical hubs; a 404 here means 'moved', not 'absent', since the underlying documents demonstrably exist.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated ČSOB CZ press-room URL was surfaced in this pass; only a direct press-release PDF (tz250213.pdf under /documents/) and the mandatory-disclosure hub were observed. Czech query 'csob.cz pro média tiskové zprávy' did not return the press index itself.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČSOB press room exists in practice but its index URL was not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ČSOB is a top-3 CZ bank; missing its press index leaves a hole in owned-channel monitoring that must be closed by site navigation rather than search.

negative_findings.description: Bank-owned channels rarely name a vendor; the vendor's own channel does. The one clear CZ core-banking vendor disclosure (KB → Temenos Transact, implementation partners named as Syncordis and LTIMindtree) appeared on temenos.com, businesswire and trade press, while KB's own IR text describes the programme as 'nová digitální banka' without vendor branding.
negative_findings.result_summary: Owned bank channels give programme names, budgets and timelines; vendor channels give vendor names. The two must be joined.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the collection design: use bank IR/annual reports as the spine (dates, capex, programme names) and vendor press rooms as the attribution layer.

negative_findings.description: No Czech bank client could be identified for Mambu or Thought Machine from vendor-owned content. The nearest CEE reference is 365.bank (Slovakia) on Backbase + Mambu.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned platform comparison pages and partner listings, not CZ deployments.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests next-gen cloud cores have little or no publicised CZ install base; CZ tier-1 modernisation is going to Temenos instead. Watch Slovakia/Poland as leading indicators.

negative_findings.description: Finastra, Tietoevry and BPC Banking Technologies produced no CZ-specific customer story or press release in search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic product/corporate pages returned; no CZ bank named.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either genuine absence from CZ or references held privately; requires direct newsroom/case-study-library crawls rather than search-engine discovery before concluding absence.

negative_findings.description: No Comarch case study for a Czech bank was found despite searching in Czech using native case-study vocabulary ('případová studie', 'reference', 'implementace').
negative_findings.result_summary: cs-language search surfaced other vendors' CZ bank case studies (Salesforce via Enehano, MS Dynamics via LLP CRM) but nothing from Comarch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Comarch's CZ banking footprint may be insurance/telco-weighted rather than banking; needs a direct crawl of comarch.com/cz case studies to confirm.

negative_findings.description: NCR Atleos: CZ appears only inside multi-country lists (contactless ATM availability, ATMaaS coverage), with no dedicated CZ bank announcement located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Country-list mentions confirmed presence; no named CZ counterparty.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Presence without a named client is a strong signal that the CZ relationship is either via a processor/ITCARD-style intermediary or contractually confidential.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice are provided as discovered from search-result metadata and content summaries; no liveness claim is made for any of them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pending deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Several are deep IR permalinks (Diebold Nixdorf /default.aspx, Euronet gcs-web mirrors) that are prone to redirect or path changes without being dead.

negative_findings.description: Most global vendors in this cell publish CZ-relevant material only in English; Czech-language vendor-owned content was found almost exclusively from CEE-headquartered vendors (Asseco) and local SIs.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs-language queries were productive for local SIs and Asseco, unproductive for Temenos/Backbase/ACI/Nexi.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection strategy must be split: English crawls for global vendor newsrooms, Czech crawls for local SI/partner reference pages.

negative_findings.description: STRV (CZ/US product studio) and Cetin / T-Mobile ICT services were named in the cell brief but no banking-sector reference, case study or client page for them surfaced in either Czech or English searches in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No STRV banking case study and no CZ telco-ICT banking reference page located; only generic corporate pages appeared. Treat as not-yet-found, not as absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a hole in the boutique-studio and telco-ICT delivery channels, both of which can hold bank digital-channel and infrastructure contracts.

negative_findings.description: The Czech phrase 'reference' and 'případová studie' are extremely noisy — searches for integrator+bank case studies return unrelated CRM vendors, moving companies (Stěhování KB), document-archiving vendors and student theses.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple queries returned mostly off-target domains (llpcrm.com, awigo.cz, easyproject.com, scribd copies) rather than the target integrators' own sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recurring collection must query vendor domains directly (site-scoped) rather than relying on open web search, or precision will stay low.

negative_findings.description: Cleverlance Enterprise Solutions' own reference/case-study page URL was not directly surfaced; evidence of its bank work (multichannel banking, Česká spořitelna application design) came only via third-party press and encyclopaedia entries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank work is evidenced but the canonical vendor reference page was not identified in this pass; its content may now sit under the Aricoma domain after the group rebranding.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cleverlance is one of the largest CZ suppliers of bank multichannel systems; missing its primary reference page understates the competitive picture.

negative_findings.description: No pass was made over LinkedIn company/employee pages, GitHub/technology-partner directories (e.g. Camunda, Temenos, Backbase, Microsoft partner finders) which list CZ implementation partners for named bank platforms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not searched in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: OEM partner directories are among the highest-yield pointer sources for identifying which CZ integrator implements which banking product.

negative_findings.description: or.justice.cz sbírka listin document retrieval typically requires session-bound navigation and serves scanned PDFs; automation feasibility was not tested here.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL and mechanism identified from documentation; no fetch attempted, so accessibility is a hypothesis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The registry is the highest-credibility source in this cell; if the UI resists automation the dataor.justice.cz bulk feed or a mirror must carry the load.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searches for GoPay partnership press releases returned only help-centre documentation and blog posts; no dedicated 'tiskové zprávy' / press-release section for GoPay was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: GoPay appears to communicate partnerships through its blog rather than a formal newsroom; partnership announcements must be reconstructed from blog posts and third-party media.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for GoPay must target the blog and ČTK wire rather than an expected /press endpoint, otherwise partnership events will be missed.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching for ThePay, Barion CZ, Adyen CZ, Stripe CZ and Revolut Business CZ returned mostly third-party integration help pages (webczech, wpjshop, Dativery) rather than the vendors' own Czech-market communications.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CZ-localized newsroom or country page was surfaced for Adyen, Stripe, Barion or Revolut in this pass; Revolut in particular did not appear in softPOS/terminal supplier results for CZ.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The international-entrant leg of the cell is currently evidenced only indirectly. Their CZ presence may have to be tracked via the ČNB/JERRS register, EU passporting notifications and merchant-side integration docs rather than vendor PR.

negative_findings.description: Searches for CZ terminal-vendor case studies (Ingenico, PAX, Verifone, distributors) returned only user manuals, ECR integration FAQs and a US retailer comparison blog — no Czech merchant case-study library.
negative_findings.result_summary: Terminal hardware vendors do not appear to publish CZ-specific case studies publicly; the closest substitutes are bank merchant manuals and ERP integration matrices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'case studies' topic for the terminal estate will have to be served by proxies (public contract register, ERP support matrices, bank manuals) rather than vendor marketing collateral.

negative_findings.description: KB SmartPay and Visa CZ newsroom entry URLs were inferred from brand names and third-party references rather than confirmed by fetching the pages during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded with reduced confidence and access_status 'unverified'; the deterministic liveness pass should resolve their canonical paths.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two significant actors (KB's acquiring arm and the Visa scheme) would otherwise be under-covered if the guessed URLs fail.

negative_findings.description: No public, enumerable registry of Bank iD RELYING PARTIES (poskytovatelé služeb / SeP) was located. Searches surfaced only the member-bank list, the implementation page, and scattered individual announcements; secondary sources explicitly advise checking the operator's own site for the current list, implying no downloadable roster.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank member list recoverable (ČS, KB, ČSOB, Air Bank, MONETA, mBank, Raiffeisenbank, Fio); relying-party list not found as a structured public artefact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The relying-party registry is the highest-value partnership pointer named in the cell rationale; without it, partnership intelligence must be reconstructed from press releases and the NIA qualified-provider list, which is slower and incomplete.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching for ČNB public procurement / supplier information for CERTIS and the instant-payment platform returned only scheme documentation, no tender notices, contract awards or supplier names.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search on 'ČNB veřejné zakázky CERTIS dodavatel' returned exclusively CERTIS rules and participant PDFs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The identity of the technology supplier behind CERTIS/instant payments is a key vendor-intelligence fact; it likely requires the national procurement register (Věstník veřejných zakázek / NEN) rather than web search, which this pass did not reach.

negative_findings.description: The COBS rulebook PDF referenced by search results (cbaonline.cz/upload/1061-cobs-rulebook-v04-1-1.pdf) and references to later versions (v2, v6.0) could not be reconciled to a canonical version index; the ČBA landing page fetched exposed no version numbers, working groups or download links.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČBA open-banking page fetched successfully but contained only introductory text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a canonical COBS version index we cannot date standard changes, which is the mechanism that links regulation to bank IT spend.

negative_findings.description: No search was run in Czech for CERTIS/instant-payments ISO 20022 migration terminology or for ČNB annual payment-system reports (Zpráva o platebním styku), so those sub-areas are undocumented in this slice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sub-area left uncovered within the time budget.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ISO 20022 migration and the annual payment-system report are standard triggers for bank infrastructure programmes.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief lists 'Bankovnictví.cz' and 'Zdroj' as outlets. Searching in Czech resolved the banking magazine to bankovnictvionline.cz (Časopis Bankovnictví), not a 'bankovnictvi.cz' news site; no Czech banking/fintech outlet named 'Zdroj' was found — the closest fit is ČTK's wire/Protext, which is how agency-sourced ('zdroj: ČTK') items are credited in Czech media.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed names corrected: Bankovnictví -> bankovnictvionline.cz; 'Zdroj/ČTK' -> ctk.cz / protext.cz / ib.ctk.cz.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the pipeline from targeting a non-existent domain and mis-attributing agency copy.

negative_findings.description: Czech query combining Investičníweb + Podnikatel.cz with bank/fintech partnership terms returned no relevant articles from either outlet; results were dominated by Roklen24 and generic finance portals.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found that Investičníweb or Podnikatel.cz carry vendor/partnership-level banking IT reporting.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two seed outlets look low-yield for A6; effort is better spent on trade IT media (SystemOnline, Computerworld, CIOtrends) and the wire.

negative_findings.description: Neither the cs nor the en query surfaced Czech reporting that names contract VALUES for a bank technology deal; the only contract-value/vendor-switch investigative reporting found was about public-sector IT (Finanční správa, tax system, IBM -> Eviden).
negative_findings.result_summary: Contract-value detail for private bank IT deals not evidenced in open Czech media within this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes trade press reveals contract values; for private banks this may only be inferable from public procurement or vendor filings, not media.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language article was found in this pass reporting a FAILED or abandoned bank IT implementation ('neúspěšná implementace', 'projekt skončil', 'banka vypověděla smlouvu' were not tested exhaustively).
negative_findings.result_summary: Failure/weak-signal coverage unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Failed-implementation signals are a stated purpose of this cell; a dedicated failure-vocabulary query round is still owed.

negative_findings.description: HN.cz and ČTK Infobanka appear to be gated (subscription / login). This is inferred from search snippets and service descriptions, not from a fetch; no liveness or paywall state was verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of the highest-credibility sources are likely commercially gated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget for subscriptions must be planned; scraping them would be a licence violation.

negative_findings.description: No Reuters or Bloomberg dedicated stream for Czech bank technology/vendor contracts was found. Searches for Reuters coverage of Komerční banka technology contracts returned only stock-data aggregators (MarketBeat, TradingView, SimplyWallSt) and Wikipedia, not wire reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Global wires cover CZ banks mainly for earnings, M&A and macro, not vendor selections; treat Reuters/Bloomberg as low-yield for this cell's topics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids spending collection budget on expensive wire monitoring that will not produce vendor/partnership signal; the vendor newswires and trade press carry that instead.

negative_findings.description: No Celent, Forrester or Gartner report specifically sizing Czech banking/payments vendor market share was located. Celent's European e-commerce payments modelling covers DE, NL, PL, ES and UK — Czechia is explicitly not in that set.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-specific analyst market-share data appears not to exist as a standalone product; CZ appears only inside CEE/Europe aggregates or in award write-ups (e.g. MONETA Money Bank Model Bank 2022).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed analysts aggregate CZ league tables; in practice CZ must be inferred from CEE-level products, IBSi deal counts, or non-analyst market reports of lower credibility.

negative_findings.description: The Czech-language seed query about foreign media reporting Czech bank technology contracts ('zahraniční média česká banka technologická smlouva oznámení dodavatel') returned only ČNB regulatory opinions and ČNB e-ZAK procurement documents — no meta-coverage of foreign reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language phrasing does not index international coverage of CZ bank deals; the productive cs-language route is querying Czech bank/vendor proper names, which surfaces English vendor wire releases (e.g. nCino/ČSOB on GlobeNewswire).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents a method correction: for this English-language cell, local-language value comes from local entity names and aliases, not from local phrasing about foreign media.

negative_findings.description: Several high-value sources in this cell (bne IntelliNews, Euromoney, American Banker/PaymentsSource, Celent, Gartner/Forrester, GlobalData) are metered or subscription-only; full-text confirmation of deal details was not possible from search results alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headlines and abstracts are retrievable; deal specifics often are not without a licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget or licence decisions are needed before these sources can be relied on for evidence rather than signal detection.

coverage_gaps.description: Contracting-authority profiles not yet pinned for ČEB, ČSSZ, Ministerstvo vnitra, Finanční správa, Celní správa, Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb (SPCSS), and regional/municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve each by IČO through the VVZ contracting-authority profile registry (each profile has a VVZ profile ID, e.g. ČNB = 342165) and record the hosting e-tool for each.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was fixed for banking/payments scope (e.g. 66-series financial services, 72-series IT services, 30144/30162 cash-register and card equipment, 48-series software packages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit CPV whitelist and drive all NEN/VVZ/Hlídač queries by cpv: prefix rather than free text, to make recall auditable.

coverage_gaps.description: TED (EU Tenders Electronic Daily) was not covered in this cell, although Czech above-threshold notices are duplicated there in structured, multilingual, bulk-downloadable form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add TED (ted.europa.eu) with country filter CZ as a complementary structured feed and a cross-check on VVZ completeness; assign to this or an adjacent cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurement-quality/analytics projects (e.g. zIndex, Otevřená smlouva/Otevřená data initiatives, EDZ analyses) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up cs search for 'zindex veřejné zakázky hodnocení zadavatelů' and similar to add derived-analytics sources that reveal vendor concentration and lock-in patterns.

coverage_gaps.description: Bulk/API access terms unknown for NEN, VVZ and Tender arena; only Registr smluv (NKOD) and Hlídač státu are confirmed to expose machine-readable paths.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and any documented open-data endpoints for NEN/NIPEZ and VVZ; if absent, plan low-rate HTML crawling and lean on Hlídač státu as the index.

coverage_gaps.description: No actor map yet of the specific Czech contracting authorities most likely to buy payments/banking IT above EU threshold — beyond ČNB and Celní správa, candidates include Ministerstvo financí, Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb, Česká pošta, ČSSZ, Generální finanční ředitelství, Czech regional and municipal authorities, and state-owned banks (Národní rozvojová banka, Exportní garanční a pojišťovací společnost).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a buyer list with ICO for each, then run standing TED and VVZ queries by buyer ID as well as by CPV — buyer-anchored queries catch contracts whose CPV coding is wrong or generic.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's premise is that TED reveals cross-border vendors (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Worldline, Nexi, Temenos, Fiserv) bidding into CZ, but no supplier-name-anchored searching was completed, and Czech-market incumbents were not enumerated (e.g. Monet+, ICZ, Asseco Central Europe, Aricoma/Cleverlance, Global Payments, Worldline Czech branch, Comdata).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run supplier-name queries directly in TED expert search (winner name contains X, country CZE) for both the international list and a curated Czech incumbent list; snowball newly-seen winner names back into the list each cycle.

coverage_gaps.description: No validated CPV whitelist for banking and payments exists yet. Only 72212443 was given as a seed; adjacent families (66100000 banking and investment services, 48xxxxxx software packages, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30xxxxxx office/cash equipment, 50xxxxxx repair and maintenance, 79xxxxxx business services) are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the official CPV list, draft a whitelist, then empirically validate it by sampling known Czech banking/payments awards and checking which codes they actually carry (real notices are frequently coded coarsely).

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language coverage was achieved for procurement procedure vocabulary and funding vocabulary, but not for technical banking-IT Czech terms that would appear in tender subject lines — e.g. 'bankovní informační systém', 'karetní centrum', 'zpracování hotovosti', 'okamžité platby', 'platební styk', 'switch pro platební karty', 'AML systém', 'core banking systém'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the glossary with these terms and re-run title-text searches in TED (Czech notice text) and VVZ; note that many Czech notices use English-in-Czech terms ('core banking', 'switch', 'acquiring'), so query both forms.

coverage_gaps.description: Oversight and audit sources that comment on EU-funded and above-threshold Czech IT contracts were not covered: ÚOHS (competition/procurement review decisions), NKÚ (Supreme Audit Office), and the European Court of Auditors. These reveal disputed and cancelled awards and named incumbents in ways award notices do not.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ÚOHS decision database (uohs.gov.cz), NKÚ audit conclusions (nku.gov.cz) and ECA reports as a follow-on discovery batch; they are pointer-rich and Czech-language.

coverage_gaps.description: Specific EU programme instruments beyond DIGITAL and NPO were not examined for Czech payments relevance: IROP (e-government), OP TAK digitalisation calls, Connecting Europe Facility Digital, InvestEU / EIF guarantees to Czech fintechs, and EDIH network members in CZ.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate each programme's Czech beneficiary/project lists via the Funding & Tenders Portal and dotaceEU.cz, filtering for financial-sector recipients.

coverage_gaps.description: TED API access requires EU Login and an API key, which has not been provisioned; no assessment of rate limits or of whether the API exposes historical (pre-eForms) notices with the same field fidelity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision an EU Login and API key early, then benchmark the API against a bulk-XML sample for a known Czech award to confirm field coverage before committing the pipeline.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass mapped the register infrastructure but did not yet materialise the actual watchlist of CZ payment institutions, e-money institutions, PSMR providers and banking-technology vendors with their IČO identifiers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one enumeration pass: pull the ČNB JERRS payment-institution/e-money/PSMR lists and an ARES NACE-based sweep (6419, 6492, 6499, 6612, 6619, 6209, 6201, 4741, 2620), reconcile to IČO, and store as the canonical CZ actor map that drives all Sbírka listin polling.

coverage_gaps.description: With ESM closed to the public, there is no confirmed replacement for beneficial-ownership evidence on privately held CZ fintechs whose shareholder of record is an opaque holding company.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess whether the organisation qualifies as an AML-obliged person able to request ESM extracts; otherwise build a triangulation method from register shareholder entries, notarial deeds in the Sbírka listin, GLEIF Level-2 data, foreign parent registers and OpenCorporates-style aggregators, and document the residual uncertainty explicitly.

coverage_gaps.description: Paid pan-European filing aggregators (Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet CZ, Orbis/Bureau van Dijk, OpenCorporates) were inferred from first principles but not searched or priced in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated commercial-aggregator scan and compare CZ filing coverage, subsidiary-tree depth and licence terms against CRIBIS before committing to a paid layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Many CZ payment vendors operate as CZ/SK pairs; the Slovak counterpart registers (ORSR, RPVS register of public sector partners, Finstat) were out of the stated CZ scope but are essential to see the full group.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope is ever widened, add ORSR/RPVS/Finstat as a sibling cell; meanwhile flag CZ entities whose parent is Slovak so the gap is visible in downstream analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of Czech statutory filings is thin: the register front-ends offer partial English UI but filed documents (výroční zpráva, zpráva o vztazích) are essentially Czech-only, sometimes as scans.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Czech-language OCR and machine translation in the extraction stage; do not assume any English filing exists for CZ-domiciled vendors.

coverage_gaps.description: For several directories (APEK 580+, SP ČR, HK ČR ~140 sector associations, AmCham) only the entry page was identified; pagination scheme, total record count and whether member entries carry structured metadata (sector, size, website) were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a structure-probing pass per directory: identify pagination/filter parameters (APEK's filters_member[letter] pattern is a confirmed example) and the member-detail URL template before committing to a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was found that specifically organises POS/terminal, ATM or cash-handling suppliers in CZ; these vendors appear only scattered across ICT UNIE, Czech ICT Alliance and APEK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat the POS/ATM supplier population as un-enumerable from the association layer; source it instead from public procurement, ČNB registers and merchant-facing gateway partner pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Working-group pages were confirmed to exist for ČBA and ICT UNIE, but it is unknown whether either publishes named participant rosters or only topic descriptions and chairs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each working-group subpage and record whether individual participants/member institutions are named; if not, fall back to conference speaker lists and consultation-response documents (e.g. ČNB/MF public-consultation outcome PDFs, which do name responding institutions).

coverage_gaps.description: German-language coverage was only touched via ČNOPK; the run scope is cs+en, so the German bilateral chamber's German-side content and the nemeckefirmy.cz database were not explored in their native language.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If German-owned financial institutions matter to the analysis, extend the language set to de for the ČNOPK sub-branch only; otherwise accept the gap explicitly.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy was established for association member lists, which are overwritten in place — so entries/exits and vendor churn cannot be reconstructed retrospectively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the collection with Webarchiv.cz and Internet Archive snapshots of ČBA, ČEFTAS, ČLFA and APEK member pages to build a back-history before starting forward diffing.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass discovered organiser sites but did not fetch the actual partner/exhibitor/speaker pages for CARDFORUM, financnictvi.konference.cz, fintechweekcee.com, itprofinance.cz or moneyfest.cz — so no named partner rosters were extracted for those events beyond what press coverage reported.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated fetch pass over the listed partner/exhibitor/speaker URLs and extract organisation names into the actor map; snapshot each before and after its event date.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor pages are overwritten each year; no back-year capture strategy exists for CZ events, though evidence of retrievable archives was seen (cardforum.cz/data/*.pdf, itprofinance.cz/historie/, financnictvi.konference.cz year URLs, sched.com for Money20/20 2018).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-event archive plan using the organiser's own year-URL pattern plus web.archive.org snapshots, so vendor entry/exit can be dated rather than just observed.

coverage_gaps.description: CEE coverage beyond CZ is thin: only Fintech Week CEE and one CzechTrade Budapest delegation were found. No SK/PL/HU/AT conference sponsor lists were enumerated, despite CZ vendors and banks operating regionally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell with SK (NBS-adjacent events, Slovak fintech associations), PL (Impact fintech, Cashless.pl events) and HU conference sponsor lists, searched in the local language of each.

coverage_gaps.description: Insurance-side and building-society events are only incidentally covered (awards mention Kooperativa, Allianz, Generali Česká) even though the run scope is sector=both. No dedicated insurtech conference or exhibitor list was enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up query set on 'pojišťovnictví konference partneři', 'insurtech Česko konference', 'ČAP konference' to close the insurance half of the cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Award coverage is strong but several award programmes are reachable only through PR syndication (Visa Awards, Zlatá koruna, Finparáda), which makes the record dependent on media rewrites rather than organiser primary data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each PR-only award, spend one targeted pass resolving the organiser's own domain and confirm whether a category/jury archive exists; promote to direct where found.

coverage_gaps.description: The 'hackathon' leg of the cell is the weakest: no stable CZ bank-hackathon results or partner pages were found, and the strongest lead (Mastercard-backed FinTechers hackathon inside Fintech Week CEE, ~1M CZK prize pool) is forward-looking rather than archived.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Set a press-monitoring rule on 'hackathon' + bank names in Czech media, and crawl fintechweekcee.com and thefintechers channels immediately after May 2026 to capture winners, mentors and sponsoring vendors.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-product keyword coverage of jobs.cz/prace.cz/StartupJobs must be done through each board's native site search, not general web search.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a keyword matrix (Temenos T24/Transact, Mambu, Finastra, Way4/OpenWay, Diebold Vynamic/Vista, NCR Activate, Adyen, Stripe, ACI, SWIFT, Camunda, Murex) x each board's search URL pattern, and poll on a weekly cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: Employee skill profiles as a category are covered only by LinkedIn, which is blocked for automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate licensed alternatives (LinkedIn Talent Insights, or CZ-specific profile aggregators) and otherwise define a manual quarterly analyst sweep of named bank IT roles.

coverage_gaps.description: Developer portals were enumerated for the large banks; the long tail (Fio, UniCredit CZ, Trinity Bank, Creditas, Max banka, credit unions, and non-bank PSPs GoPay/ComGate/Twisto) is not yet individually catalogued.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the cz-banking-psd2 repo, apiportal.cz and openbankingtracker CZ index as seeds and catalogue each remaining institution's portal and GitHub presence.

coverage_gaps.description: Engineering-community artefacts beyond job ads — CZ meetups, conference speaker lists, and their vendor sponsors — were only touched indirectly via the IT Trendy event calendar.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Catalogue CZ tech meetup/conference platforms and extract bank-engineer talks and vendor sponsorship as a distinct weak-signal channel.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs in this slice are search-derived and unverified for liveness; several (apiportal.cz, apiportal.moneta.cz, developers.csob.cz) were never fetched directly in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/robots pass over every candidate URL before enabling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Heureka.cz merchant/product reviews and Reddit (r/czech, r/Prague, r/czechrepublic) were not yet mined for payment-failure and gateway-complaint threads in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated cs and en searches and, where permitted, API/RSS collection on Heureka merchant reviews and Reddit CZ subreddits filtered on 'platební brána', 'nefunguje platba', 'nesedla platba', 'chargeback'.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement records (Věstník veřejných zakázek, TED) for transit/rail/municipal payment-acceptance tenders were not searched, yet they are the most reliable route to naming acquirers and terminal vendors behind transport deployments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz and TED for 'odbavovací systém', 'platební terminály', 'akceptace platebních karet' by DPP, ČD, DPMB, ROPID and regional IDS bodies.

coverage_gaps.description: Other large CZ merchant groups and marketplaces were not covered: Mall/Allegro CZ, Kaufland, Billa, Tesco/Globus, Dr.Max, Datart, Zásilkovna/Packeta and Benzina/ORLEN fuel retail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the merchant payment-options page diffing programme to these actors and check their privacy/subprocessor pages for named PSPs.

coverage_gaps.description: No technical checkout-fingerprinting method is yet defined for identifying a merchant's PSP from public checkout assets/domains, which is the only scalable way to fill provider-attribution gaps.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a ToS-respecting method (public page asset/domain inspection, no account creation, no transaction attempts) and validate it against known cases such as Alza→Adyen.

coverage_gaps.description: Cvak itself (the A2A scheme operator behind Albert and Lidl adoption, associated notably with Air Bank) has not had its own corporate/product site, bank partner release notes, or ČNB licence record identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and profile the Cvak operating entity, its ČNB registration, participating banks (Air Bank, Fio, mBank, Moneta) and merchant pipeline; treat as a priority emerging competitor to card rails.

coverage_gaps.description: ČOI (Česká obchodní inspekce) and the EU ODR platform were not examined as complaint channels for e-shop payment disputes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check coi.cz decision/inspection publications and ODR statistics for payment-related e-commerce disputes in CZ.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact JERRS open-data p_seznam id (if any) covering platební instituce, instituce elektronických peněz, PPSMR and VEPMR was not established; only ids 1, 2, 3 and 7 were evidenced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate p_seznam values against https://jerrs.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad/JERRS.OPENDATA.STAHUJ?p_seznam=N and record which ids return payments-sector datasets; capture the paired JSON schema for each.

coverage_gaps.description: JERRS search/detail URL patterns were not mapped — only the login/entry URL was observed. Deep-link structure for a single entity record and for a filtered list by licence type is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Interactively walk JERRS in a browser, capture the URL/parameter grammar for entity detail pages and licence-type filters, and record whether stable permalinks by IČO exist.

coverage_gaps.description: AML supervision (Finanční analytický úřad, FAÚ) and cyber/ICT supervision (NÚKIB) were not searched in this slice; both regulate CZ payment providers and publish annual reports and, in FAÚ's case, guidance naming typologies and obliged-entity categories.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run cs queries such as 'Finanční analytický úřad výroční zpráva povinné osoby platební instituce' and 'NÚKIB regulovaný subjekt bankovnictví významný informační systém' and add resulting sources.

coverage_gaps.description: The relationship between the ČNB JERRS entry set and the EBA PSD2 register CZ subset (reported as ~201 entities via a third-party mirror, not verified at EBA) has not been reconciled, including passporting-in TPPs that have no CZ establishment.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download the EBA register bulk file, filter home/host = CZ, and diff against JERRS on legal name and national identifier to produce a single deduplicated CZ payments actor master list.

coverage_gaps.description: Register snapshots are point-in-time; no evidence was found of a ČNB-published historical archive of register states, so entry/exit history of payment institutions cannot be reconstructed from the register alone.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin snapshotting the registers and CERTIS/instant-payments participant PDFs on a fixed cadence to build an internal time series; backfill partially from versioned CERTIS PDFs and annual supervision reports.

coverage_gaps.description: No owned press-room or IR source located for Fio banka and only an inferred one for Banka CREDITAS; Air Bank's press room (as opposed to its annual-report PDFs) was also not observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Navigate these three domains directly (fio.cz, creditas.cz, airbank.cz) from the homepage nav to capture canonical 'pro média' / 'tiskové zprávy' / 'pro investory' paths, rather than relying on search indexing.

coverage_gaps.description: Owned recruitment/careers channels were not explored. CZ bank job postings (kariera.csas.cz, KB, ČSOB careers, plus their LinkedIn pages) name concrete technologies — core platform, cloud provider, middleware — far more explicitly than press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add each bank's careers site as a source subtype 'careers/job postings' and treat required-skill lists as vendor-stack evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: DORA-driven ICT third-party disclosures and outsourcing registers, and Pillar 3 / operational-risk sections of bank reports, were not separately profiled — these are the highest-density owned source of material-vendor names now in force in the EU.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Profile each bank's Pillar 3 disclosure page and check whether any DORA register-of-information summary is published on the bank's own site or via ČNB.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feeds or structured newsroom APIs were identified for any of the press rooms profiled, so all collection is HTML-scrape based and fragile to redesign.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During verification, probe /rss, /feed and sitemap.xml on each bank domain and record feed URLs where they exist.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language versions of the CZ press rooms were not systematically checked; several banks publish only a subset of releases in English, and group-level English releases (Erste, KBC, SG, RBI, UniCredit) may carry vendor names dropped from the Czech text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank, add both the /cs and /en press paths, plus the parent group's press room (KBC for ČSOB, SG for KB, RBI for Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit SpA for UniCredit CZ, PPF for Air Bank).

coverage_gaps.description: FIS and Fiserv were named in the cell brief but not searched individually in this pass; neither surfaced incidentally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated queries and direct newsroom crawls for FIS, Fiserv and Global Payments against CZ bank and PSP names.

coverage_gaps.description: CZ-side actor map is thin: searches gravitated to KB, ČSOB, Česká spořitelna and Air Bank. Missing: Moneta Money Bank, Raiffeisenbank CZ, UniCredit Bank CZ, Fio banka, Trinity Bank, Banka CREDITAS, Partners Banka, Revolut/Wise CZ presence, and PSPs (GoPay, ComGate, Global Payments s.r.o., Monet+).

coverage_gaps.description: Hyperscaler and platform partner case studies (Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Red Hat) were not systematically searched, yet the cs search showed Salesforce/Enehano and MS Dynamics CZ bank studies exist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the customer-story libraries of Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce and Red Hat filtered to Czech financial services; these are high-volume pointer sources for CZ bank tech stacks.

coverage_gaps.description: No use was made of web archives to recover withdrawn or relocated vendor case studies and reference lists.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query the Wayback Machine CDX API for /success-stor*, /case-stud*, /reference*, /pripadove-studie* paths on each vendor domain and diff snapshots over time to catch removed CZ client names.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech IT/banking trade media that republish vendor announcements (e.g. Lupa.cz, ChannelWorld.cz, ITBiz, SystemOnLine, Bankovnictvi/Bankovnictví magazine, Měšec.cz) were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a cs-language trade-media pass using terms 'dodavatel bankovního systému', 'nasazení', 'zakázka', 'implementace jádra' alongside vendor names.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest agendas and speaker lists from vendor event sites for CZ bank affiliations.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to .sk/.pl/.hu domains of each cell actor and re-run the reference/case-study crawl in Slovak and Polish.

coverage_gaps.description: OEM/product-vendor partner directories (Camunda, Microsoft, SAP, Temenos, Diebold Nixdorf, Backbase, Salesforce) that list certified CZ implementation partners were not harvested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate partner-finder pages for each banking product known to be in use in CZ and filter to Czech partners; this inverts the mapping from vendor->bank to product->integrator.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement channels were not searched: Registr smluv, Věstník veřejných zakázek and NEN reveal IT contracts with state-linked financial institutions (ČNB, ČMZRB/NRB, EGAP, ČEB, Česká pošta / Poštovní spořitelna perimeter).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query smlouvy.gov.cz and vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz for each integrator name to obtain contract values and dates — the only source giving priced, dated bank-adjacent deals.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshots of each vendor's /reference and /pripadove-studie paths back ~10 years and diff — removed logos are a strong lost-account signal.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Always crawl /cs/ and /en/ trees in parallel and add Slovak query variants ('referencie', 'prípadová štúdia', 'banka', 'platobné karty').
